title: Kimi Unknown sessionId on ACP resume leaves repeated dispatch failures without recovery guidance
outcome: Diagnose the user-reported repeated Kimi ACP session/resume rejection and provide an explicit, non-destructive recovery path. Preserve the existing TermAl transcript and external-session identity until a verified same-conversation recovery succeeds or the user explicitly chooses a fresh session. A mailbox wake or generic Resume must not silently replace the conversation or conceal repeated continuity failure.
acceptance: A regression covers repeated resume rejection and mailbox/queue wake behavior: retained transcript/external id and queued user work are not lost or silently moved to a new provider session, and the UI exposes the continuity failure and recovery action.

Any automatic recovery uses a verified provider contract for the same conversation; generic JSON-RPC -32602 or error prose alone never clears the saved id or creates a replacement conversation. A fresh-session recovery is explicit and preserves access to old history.
Relevant regression checks and the full gate pass on the reviewed input; the independent review pair has no unresolved in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.

The holder records a source-backed diagnosis distinguishing lost/deleted provider state, launch cwd/profile mismatch, and runtime/session lifecycle defects, with the tested Kimi build and exact recovery method stated; unproven causes remain labelled hypotheses.
